title: Provision and Validate EC2 Targets Behind an Application Load Balancer

items.evidence: Before teardown, the record must show exactly two intended healthy targets, at least six successful load-balancer requests observing both instance IDs, and application-port ingress sourced only from the load balancer security group.
The record must identify the /healthz response-code mismatch, document the correction to /ready without widening ingress, and provide a reproducible rollback trigger and action.
The record must inventory the learner-created EC2, load-balancer, target-group, and security-group resources, show every inventoried ID removed, and report zero remaining chargeable resources.
